title: Supported projective-line Chern arrow
statement:
For a prime $\ell$, finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, finite quotient $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$, and a scheme $S$ where $\ell$ is invertible, define the pro-etale Chern map from the supported Cartier Kummer class of the infinity divisor of $\mathbf P^1_S$. Convert its target using the root-normalized comparison to the specified inverse-limit twist. Its adjoint under $Lq^*\dashv Rq_*$ is $h^p$. The shifted twisted adjunction unit is $u^p$, with the canonical finite-line pullback comparison. These arrows use no ordinary decomposition or ordinary trace.

Use the recorded objects and canonical maps of [def-pur-conventions] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section] [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback] [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback] [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map] [def-amb-p1-trace] [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate] [def-amb-vector-integration] [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace] [cor-pur-vector-bundle-purity] [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-amb-etale-compact-support] [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed] [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] [lem-amb-finite-tate-site-descent] [def-sp-p1-comparison-arrows] [lem-kun-tensor-sym] [def-pur-vector-purity-normalization] [def-pur-open-site-comparison-arrows] [def-pur-bounded-site-transpose-arrows] [def-sf-compact-support-site-comparison-construction] [def-pur-finite-site-coordinates]. The ordinary bundle compact-support, adjunction, twisted-pullback and projection coordinates are those of [def-pur-vector-integration-adjunction-arrows].
